audit.why: 46.83% win rate justifies TRICKY at 7/10 with Kled carry 7.5/10; the mirror left difficulty untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: Row 0 read Skill and row 6 read Kled, against a packet chart of Sylas on both — and against the page's own whys, which say Kled has no mounted Q at level 1 and that two AP items make W an outlast engine that burns his remount.
audit.why: packet.levelChart plus the mirror, which flipped these two rows to Sylas at 4/10.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 6 to Sylas at 4/10 as matched full/content pairs, with both full-layer whys rewritten to say why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Bear Trap on a Rope carried no cooldown, so 'commit on its cooldown' had no window attached; Kled's R was written as 'Chaaaaarge!!!' with four A's when the real name has eight.
audit.why: Kit: Q 11/10/9/8/7s, Jousting E 13/12/11/10/9s, Violent Tendencies W 13/12/11/10/9s, R 'Chaaaaaaaarge!!!' at 140/125/110s. Dodging the trap removes his engage while E is his only remaining reposition.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries the Q and E numbers and what dodging buys; spikes[2] spells the R correctly and gives its 140s cost.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells the reader what Kled's burst looks like as it starts.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule autoreset-burst-tell: Violent Tendencies is an auto reset granting four fast attacks with the fourth amplified, so the visual cue is the attack-speed burst, not a spell cast.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d now describes the four-attack window and the amplified fourth.

edits.before: Q poke is your only level-1 tool — chain it on his step-ups but don't force anything; your power arrives with levels.
edits.after: He has no Bear Trap until level 2 — chain Q on his approach and bank the HP lead before the grab comes online.

edits.before: Two items plus a stolen ult makes you a teamfight flex — flank, burst the carry, and steal the scariest R on cooldown.
edits.after: Two AP items make W an outlast engine — force the long duel, burn his remount, and finish a Skaarl-less Kled.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — The hook starts his all-in — dodge it and disengage his remount. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E1 shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — 11/10/9/8/7s, and his Jousting E is 13s at rank 1; dodge the trap and both his engage and his exit are gone. - Your E1 shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: That’s Kled’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies gives him four fast attacks — the fourth hits hardest.

edits.before: Kled's R (Chaaaaarge!!!) is a weak steal for Sylas — it buffs allies but gives you no kill threat, so your level-6 spike is blunted compared to most matchups.
edits.after: Kled's R (Chaaaaaaaarge!!!) is a weak steal — a 140s charge that buffs allies but gives no kill threat, so your level-6 spike is blunted compared to most matchups.

notes: content.late says 'your chain of E2 stun into Q slow into W burst'. Per the mirror's finding on Abscond/Abduct, the recast pulls Sylas to the target and no stun is stated in Riot's text; the kit carries no hardCC flag on E. I did not edit it because absent flags mean unknown, but 'E2 stun' appears here and 'no stun' appears in four other fields as a shared boilerplate string — a champion-level decision on that phrase is needed before either can be fixed cleanly.
